name: glowing-stars
blurb: Card with animated glowing stars grid that intensifies on hover.
description: Card component wrapping an animated star grid that glows randomly on a loop. Brightness increases on hover. Includes helper components for title and description.
use_when: Hero cards, feature cards, or testimonials with a tech/space aesthetic.
a11y: Animated stars are decorative. Card and text components are semantic and don't depend on animation.
